raw_segments.text: Solicitor, I think. I know his face. Menten, John Henry, solicitor, commissioner for oaths
and affidavits. Dignum used to be in his office. Matt Dillons long ago. Jolly Matt. Convivial
evenings. Cold fowl, cigars, the tantalous glasses. Heart of gold, really. Yes, Menten.
Got his rag out that evening on the bowling green because I sailed inside him. Pure fluke
of mind, the bias. Why he took such a rooted dislike to me. Hate at first sight."
Molly and Floey Dillon linked under the lillic tree, laughing. Fellow always like that,
